note: Latest policy-rate decisions recorded on 20 October 2026 from official central-bank statements. Other banks stay on this researched record until a free decision feed is wired.

banks.summary: Raised the target range by 25 bp to 3.75–4.00%.
banks.note: Shown as the target range. The 27–28 October 2026 meeting had not announced a decision when this was recorded.
Bank Rate 2.50% and the deposit rate 2.20% were unchanged. The last change was a cut on 29 October 2025. The next decision, on 28 October 2026, had not been announced.
Announced 17 September 2026 after a meeting that ended on 16 September. The vote was 6–3. The next decision is 5 November 2026.

banks.summary: Raised the deposit facility rate by 25 bp to 2.50%.
banks.note: One decision covers Germany, France and Italy. The main refinancing rate is 2.65% and the marginal lending facility is 2.90%, effective 16 September 2026. The previous deposit rate was 2.25%.

banks.summary: Raised the overnight call rate by 25 bp to around 1.25%.
banks.note: The previous guide was around 1.0%, set on 16 June 2026. The meeting that concludes on 30 October 2026 had not announced a decision.

banks.summary: Raised the cash rate target by 25 bp to 4.60%.
banks.note: Effective 30 September 2026. There was no October decision. The next meeting is 3 November 2026.

banks.summary: Held the 7-day reverse repo rate at 1.40%.
banks.note: The 19 October 2026 open-market operation was CNY 80 billion at an unchanged 1.40%. The last change was a 10 bp cut from 1.50% to 1.40%, effective 8 May 2025. The PBoC has no fixed-date policy meeting; this confirms the rate, it is not a new change. No overnight policy rate has been announced.

banks.summary: Raised the policy repo rate by 25 bp to 5.50%.
banks.note: The stance moved to calibrated tightening. The standing deposit facility is 5.25% and the marginal standing facility and Bank Rate are 5.75%. The next MPC meeting is 2–4 December 2026.
